description: Real-time webcam streaming in Minecraft! A Fabric mod that captures your webcam and renders it on your player's skin. Features: toggle keybinding, multi-camera support, multiplayer streaming, and configurable resolution/FPS.

releases.notes:
## WebcamHead v1.1.0.19

**Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.x** (all 1.21 versions)

### Changes
- compatibilty with 1.21.x (ee896e1)

---

### Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader for your Minecraft 1.21.x version
2. Download and install Fabric API (1.21.x compatible version)
3. Place this mod JAR in your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft and press **V** to activate webcam!
